title: Places giving out free money in South Florida

scenes.text: These places in South Florida are giving out money, and most people have no idea.
scenes.caption: These places in South Florida are giving out money, and most people have no idea.

scenes.text: The City of Miami will put up to two hundred thousand dollars toward a first home in District Five, for buyers who qualify. It's a zero percent loan with no monthly payments, and it's forgiven if you keep the home for thirty years.
scenes.caption: The City of Miami will put up to $200,000 toward a first home in District 5, for buyers who qualify. It's a 0% loan with no monthly payments, and it's forgiven if you keep the home for 30 years.

scenes.text: Broward County gives first time buyers up to eighty thousand dollars. There are no monthly payments, and after fifteen years in the home, it turns into a grant you never pay back.
scenes.caption: Broward County gives first-time buyers up to $80,000. There are no monthly payments, and after 15 years in the home, it turns into a grant you never pay back.

scenes.text: The University of Miami pays people to take part in research. Most psychology study visits take thirty minutes to an hour, and they're paid.
scenes.caption: The University of Miami pays people to take part in research. Most psychology study visits take 30 minutes to an hour, and they're paid.

scenes.text: And plasma centers pay too. Centers in Hialeah and on Calle Ocho pay about fifty to eighty dollars a visit, and new donors can earn hundreds more in bonuses their first month.
scenes.caption: And plasma centers pay too. Centers in Hialeah and on Calle Ocho pay about $50 to $80 a visit, and new donors can earn hundreds more in bonuses their first month.

scenes.text: Money like this sits right in your own neighborhood and most people never notice it, just like most of the people they pass every day, and that second part is what NEAR is for. Send this to someone who's trying to buy a house.

igCaption:
Places giving out free money in South Florida 💸

🏠 City of Miami: up to $200,000 toward a first home in District 5 (0% loan, no monthly payments, forgiven after 30 years) — 305-416-2080
🔑 Broward County: up to $80,000 for first-time buyers, becomes a grant after 15 years
🧠 University of Miami: paid research studies (30–60 min visits)
💵 Plasma centers (Hialeah, Calle Ocho): about $50–$80 a visit + new donor bonuses

Income limits apply for the home programs. Send this to someone who's trying to buy a house 👀

#Miami #SouthFlorida #FirstTimeHomeBuyer #MoneyTips
sources: miami.gov District 5 Expanded First-Time Homebuyer Program: up to $200,000, 30-year deferred 0% loan, repaid if sold before 30 years, 120% AMI (140% first responders), $500k max price, 305-416-2080
NBC 6 Responds: Broward HPA up to $80,000, 15-year 0% second mortgage with no monthly payments that converts to a grant after 15 years, 80% AMI
University of Miami Psychology, Research Participation: most visits 30–60 minutes and compensated
